title: Get Vendors Meta Filter
description: Operates on Vendors. In the Zuper client app this module is labeled "Vendor" for most companies, and "Supplier" for companies in the roofing industry — the API and data shape are identical either way. Vendors and Subcontractors share the exact same underlying schema and endpoints; they're distinguished only by the `vendor_type` field (`VENDOR` here) and the `/vendors` vs `/subcontractors` route prefix. Returns the set of fields available to filter on for this module, along with each field's supported operators.
